title: reviews.jsonl line
description: One review comment per line of .standards/reviews.jsonl. Written by scripts/fetch-reviews.mjs, or by hand when the script is missing or fails.

id.description: Stable and unique across the file. Use the forge's own comment ID, or the commit SHA for git-log records, prefixed by source, such as forge:123456 or git-log:3f2a9c1.

source.description: forge when the record came from the forge's CLI or API; git-log when no forge was reachable.

kind.description: inline-comment is attached to a line of the diff. review-body is the summary text of a review. thread-reply answers another comment. commit is a git-log record whose message addresses review feedback.

change.description: The pull or merge request number the comment belongs to, as a string. null for commit records with no known change.

author.description: The commenter's login, or the commit author's name for git-log records.

author_is_bot.description: true when the forge marks the account as a bot or app, or its login ends in a bot suffix such as [bot].

created_at.description: When the comment or commit was made, in RFC 3339 form.

body.description: The comment text, or the full commit message, unedited.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file the comment is attached to. null when the comment is not attached to a file.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file, when the forge gives one.

diff_hunk.description: The diff hunk the comment sits on, when the forge gives one. For commit records, the commit's diff trimmed to the files it touches.

commit.description: The commit SHA the comment was made against, or the commit itself for git-log records.

in_reply_to.description: The id of the record this one replies to, for thread-reply records.

url.description: The forge's web link to the comment, kept as data so a § can cite it.
